svg.text: The ZeRO ladder: shard more, hold less (70B model, N = 64 GPUs)
One row per stage - each box is one GPU, and every GPU in the row holds the same thing
optimizer states: fp32 master + Adam m + v
A sliver is your 1/64 slice. The other 63/64 lives on the other GPUs and is all-gathered
per layer, just in time, then dropped. Full-width strip = the whole component, replicated.
ZeRO-3 per GPU = Day 73's 1,120 GB total / 64 = 17.5 GB. FSDP (PyTorch) shards like ZeRO-3; DeepSpeed ZeRO climbs the ladder.
